fields.Name: Bylaws
fields.Description: Highest governing charter, articles of incorporation, or organizational bylaws. Supersedes all lower-tier policies and manuals.

fields.Name: Board Policy
fields.Description: Board-approved governance resolution or enterprise-wide policy mandate.

fields.Name: Executive SOP
fields.Description: Executive standard operating procedure or official cross-department operational manual.

fields.Name: Department Practice
fields.Description: Department-scoped playbook, desk manual, or team operating convention.

fields.Name: Reference
fields.Description: General reference documentation, knowledge base article, or training guide.

fields.Name: Inferred
fields.Description: Unverified or machine-inferred observation extracted from unstructured content awaiting human review.
